people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.
translations.bsb: But the Egyptians mistreated us and afflicted us, putting us to hard labor.
translations.kjv: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
translations.asv: And the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
